name: Greedy Fortune Pig

features.name: Expanding walking wilds
features.description: Wilds expand, respin and step one reel left.

features.name: Money collection
features.description: Wilds collect all money symbol values.

review:
A money-collect game with walking wilds. Money symbols worth up to 100x get collected when a wild lands with them. Wilds also expand over their reel, trigger a respin and walk one reel left, repeating until they leave the grid.

Each step adds 1x to a multiplier for later wins in the respins. Three bonus symbols give 5 to 8 free spins, where that multiplier lasts the whole feature. A clever combo. Up to 8,888x, 96.5% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
